description: Permission and permission-set rules
applyTo: "**/Permissions/**/*.al,**/*Permission*.al"
---

# Permission and permission-set rules

- Grant least privilege required by the scenario.
- Avoid wildcard or unnecessarily broad permissions.
- Distinguish direct and indirect access requirements where relevant.
- Review permission impact whenever new tables, APIs, reports, or background processes are added.
- Do not weaken existing security to bypass an authorization error.
